comparison.objective: Hang a deformable cable across two hooks with specified sag; candidate adjusts and locks a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Cable shape/slack control and hook placement versus coaxial driver seating, jam-nut wrenching, and countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Cable released in both cradles with 4–6 cm sag versus retained 90° stop after three articulated cycles and tool clearance.
comparison.reason: The tested abilities, manipulated mechanisms, and outcomes are meaningfully different.
